scope: Independent specialist review with real-feature comparisons and mocked main-loop routing; no real model fit.

material_fix.issue: A selection_source config could omit early_stopping_rounds, pass frozen_selection because .get returned None, then enable100-round validation stopping via the default in main.
material_fix.resolution: Any validated selection_source now forces stopping=None. The raw2021 no-source default remains100.

metadata_fix: Added output_columns to reports so full-fit partial predictions carry explicit target schema and are compatible with specialist component readers.
score_interpretation: Target-only early stopping uses the target generator AUC. Its best count must be frozen for confirmation/full fit; standalone specialist gains must be assessed again under the entire current frozen ensemble because micro-AUC includes cross-generator comparisons.

full_fit_blending.compatible_exporter: src/make_goal_submission.py accepts partial component sources when they contain every output for the plant. Haukeli and Lio each have one generator, so their168-column files qualify.
full_fit_blending.required_recipe: Replace only the target plant XGBoost source with the specialist source at the existing XGBoost weight, retaining LightGBM/Transformer contributions. If the preselected historical variant averages old and new XGBoost, split the original XGBoost weight equally between shared and specialist sources.
full_fit_blending.warning: The legacy make_specialist_submission direct route replaces the final generator forecast, not just the XGBoost component; that would not reproduce this experiment unless its complete recipe were intentionally rebuilt.

limits: 2021 specialist cap2200 differs from the current shared baseline cap1500; this experiment changes capacity allocation and allowed tree budget, not architecture alone. Non-cap tree parameters and features match.
2021 early stopping selects on target AUC, while promotion must use the final ensemble pooled micro-AUC.
2021/2022 are reused development years; fixed counts remove fresh2022 stopping selection but not historical reuse or2022-selected retained components.
If claiming no selection-horizon overlap, also report2022Jan7 onward; the first six daily starts overlap2021validation-label horizons.
Current scripts intentionally do not create a full competition submission from partial specialist probabilities.
